content.Guideline Overview: The document provides guidelines on the management of peripheral artery disease with a focus on various surgical and nonsurgical interventions for conditions like critical limb ischemia, diabetes-related foot complications, and wound care.
Interventions: Use of pedal and distal venous arterialization for critical limb ischemia.
Comparison of critical ischemic foot management strategies.
Use of fibregrafts and fibroblasts for foot ulcers.
